name: game-art
description: Gera assets de jogo (sprite, ícone, textura, fundo, UI, concept) pelo gerador de imagens do Codex CLI, limpa o fundo e salva na pasta certa do projeto Godot, Unity ou Unreal.

codexModel.title: Codex model
codexModel.description: Model passed to `codex exec -m`. Empty uses the model from ~/.codex/config.toml.

generationTimeoutMs.title: Generation timeout (ms)
generationTimeoutMs.description: How long one Codex generation may take before it is abandoned (at most 600000).
